resources.string: Pixel count relative to the OpenXR recommended resolution. 100% uses the recommendation; higher values improve detail at a performance cost. Changes apply on the next game launch.

Enable Vivecraft’s Lanczos resampling filter, which can be used with a render scale above 100%. Increases rendering cost; changes apply on the next game launch.
Wait for both eyes to finish rendering before submitting VR frames to reduce flicker with demanding shaders. May lower game frame rate. Applies on the next game launch.
